terms_of_service.title: TERMS OF SERVICE
terms_of_service.introduction:
Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using our website or engaging Growlane for any services. By accessing thegrowlane.com or entering into a service agreement with us, you agree to be bound by these terms.

If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our website or services.

sections.title: ABOUT US
sections.content: Growlane is a digital marketing and web development agency operating in India. We provide services including website design and development, mobile app development, search engine optimisation (SEO), social media marketing, paid advertising, brand identity, and related digital services.

subsections.heading: 2.1 Scope of Work
subsections.content: All services provided by Growlane will be defined in a separate Service Agreement, Project Proposal, or Statement of Work (SOW) shared with the client prior to commencement.

subsections.heading: 2.2 Timelines
subsections.content: We commit to delivering work within agreed timelines. Delays caused by the client (e.g. late content, feedback, or approvals) may result in revised delivery dates. Growlane will not be held liable for delays arising from client-side dependencies.

subsections.heading: 2.3 Revisions
subsections.content: The number of revisions included in each project will be specified in the project proposal. Additional revisions beyond the agreed scope may be charged separately.

subsections.heading: 2.4 Third-Party Tools and Platforms
subsections.content: Certain services may involve third-party platforms (e.g. Shopify, WordPress, Google Ads, Meta Ads). Growlane is not responsible for changes, outages, or policy updates made by these third-party platforms.

subsections.heading: 3.1 Payment Terms
points: A minimum advance of 50% of the total project value is required before work begins
The remaining balance is due upon project completion, before final delivery or handover
Monthly retainer fees are due on or before the 1st of each billing month

subsections.heading: 3.2 Late Payments
subsections.content: Payments not received within 7 days of the due date may result in a pause of ongoing work. Growlane reserves the right to charge a late fee of 2% per month on overdue amounts.

subsections.heading: 3.3 Refunds
subsections.content: Advance payments are non-refundable once work has commenced, unless Growlane is unable to deliver the agreed scope of work. Refund requests will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

subsections.heading: 3.4 Taxes
subsections.content: All prices are exclusive of applicable taxes. GST or any other statutory taxes will be added to invoices as required under Indian tax law.

subsections.heading: 4.1 Client Ownership
subsections.content: Upon receipt of full payment, all deliverables created specifically for the client (websites, designs, content, logos) become the property of the client.

subsections.heading: 4.2 Growlane Ownership
subsections.content: Growlane retains ownership of all tools, frameworks, methodologies, and pre-existing intellectual property used in delivering the services. Open-source tools used in your project remain governed by their respective licences.

subsections.heading: 4.3 Portfolio Rights
subsections.content: Growlane reserves the right to showcase completed work in our portfolio, case studies, and marketing materials, unless the client explicitly requests confidentiality in writing.

subsections.heading: 4.4 Third-Party Assets
subsections.content: If the project requires stock images, fonts, plugins, or licensed software, the client is responsible for obtaining and paying for the appropriate licences unless otherwise agreed.

sections.title: CLIENT RESPONSIBILITIES
sections.content: To enable timely and quality delivery, the client agrees to:
points: Provide all required content, assets, and information in a timely manner
Designate a single point of contact for approvals and communication
Review and provide feedback within agreed timelines
Ensure that all content provided does not infringe upon any third-party intellectual property or law
Make payments as per the agreed schedule
sections.note: Failure to meet these responsibilities may impact project timelines and quality, for which Growlane will not be held liable.

sections.title: CONFIDENTIALITY
sections.content: Both parties agree to keep confidential any sensitive business information shared during the course of the engagement. Growlane will not disclose client business information, strategies, or data to any third party without prior written consent, except where required by law.

sections.title: LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
sections.content: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable Indian law:
points: Growlane's total liability for any claim arising from our services shall not exceed the total amount paid by the client for the specific project or service in question
Growlane is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages including loss of revenue, loss of data, or loss of business opportunity
Results from digital marketing services (SEO, ads, social media) cannot be guaranteed as they depend on external factors outside our control

subsections.heading: 8.1 By the Client
subsections.content: The client may terminate a project by providing 14 days written notice. Work completed up to the termination date will be invoiced and must be paid in full. The advance payment is non-refundable.

subsections.heading: 8.2 By Growlane
subsections.content: Growlane reserves the right to terminate a project or service agreement if:
points: The client fails to make payment within the agreed terms
The client requests work that violates any law or ethical standard
The working relationship becomes untenable despite reasonable efforts to resolve issues
subsections.note: In such cases, deliverables completed up to the termination date will be invoiced and must be paid.

sections.title: DISPUTE RESOLUTION
sections.content:
In the event of any dispute arising from these terms or our services, both parties agree to first attempt to resolve the matter amicably through good-faith discussion.

If a resolution cannot be reached within 30 days, the dispute shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts of India, in accordance with the laws of the Republic of India.

sections.title: GOVERNING LAW
sections.content: These Terms of Service shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of India, including but not limited to the Information Technology Act, 2000, the Indian Contract Act, 1872, and the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

sections.title: CHANGES TO THESE TERMS
sections.content:
Growlane reserves the right to update these Terms of Service at any time. The revised terms will be posted on this page with an updated "Last Updated" date.

Continued use of our website or services after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the updated terms.
